subject.title: [Bug]: WebChat can render assistant reply before user prompt and duplicate inbound messages

question: Should #95566 remain the combined WebChat send-durability tracker until current-main proof covers both visible ordering and duplicate user context, or should maintainers split/close it under narrower trackers like #98001, #85771, and #69208?
rationale: The source-backed evidence shows multiple partial fixes and trackers, but no merged current-main proof covers the exact combined user-visible and context-assembly symptom.

options.title: Keep Combined Tracker
options.body: Keep #95566 open as the combined symptom until #80670 or a replacement proves the full visible-order plus duplicate-context behavior on current main.

options.title: Split To Narrow Trackers
options.body: Treat #98001 as the UI ordering owner and #85771/#69208 as duplicate transcript owners, then close #95566 only after maintainers accept losing the combined repro thread.

options.title: Define ACK Durability Contract First
options.body: Pause repair until maintainers decide whether chat.send ACK must require durable user-turn visibility before agent dispatch or may remain runtime-owned.

recommendation.title: Keep Combined Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep #95566 open as the combined symptom until #80670 or a replacement proves the full visible-order plus duplicate-context behavior on current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest remaining implementation decision is the shared user-turn recorder and Gateway durability boundary.
